title: Pope Leo Defends ‘Human Art’ vs AI, Calls for Church to ‘Renew an Alliance with Artists’ to ‘Safeguard Our Humanity’
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Pope Leo Defends ‘Human Art’ vs AI, Calls for Church to ‘Renew an Alliance with Artists’ to ‘Safeguard Our Humanity’

Pope Leo XIV defended the importance of "human art" versus art created by artificial intelligence (AI), and called for the church to "renew an alliance with artists and cultural institutions."
The post Pope Leo Defends ‘Human Art’ vs AI, Calls for Church to ‘Renew an Alliance with Artists’ to ‘Safeguard Our Humanity’ appeared first on Breitbart.
